appraisal_events.evidence: j'avais une femme à moi qui, au premier mot que je lui envoyais à l'improviste, me faisait téléphoner avec déférence qu'elle revenait, qu'elle se laissait ramener, aussitôt. J'étais plus maître que je n'avais cru. Plus maître, c'est-à-dire plus esclave.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator casts Albertine as an obedient possession who complies instantly and deferentially with his summons, framing his relationship to her in terms of mastery and domination; he immediately complicates this by noting that his greater mastery is inseparably a greater servitude for himself.

appraisal_events.evidence: « Voulez-vous sortir, grand pied de grue, grand pied de grue, grand pied de grue »... « allez chercher votre oncle pour que je lui dise ce que vous êtes, putain. »; Morel, sachant... était extrêmement poltron, se hâta de sortir dès qu'il l'entendit dans la cour.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator reports Morel's crude, repeated verbal cruelty toward Jupien's niece and then his cowardly flight the instant real confrontation with Jupien threatens, exposing the bluster of his earlier feigned wish to summon Jupien as empty and self-serving.

status_effects.explanation: She is positioned as compliant and possessed, deferring instantly to the narrator's whim, which subordinates her within the relationship as narrated here.
He recognizes himself as more fully 'master' of Albertine than he had realized, since she obeys his summons immediately and deferentially.
He immediately qualifies this mastery as itself a form of enslavement ('plus esclave'), signaling that his control over Albertine binds him as much as it empowers him.
His gratuitous cruelty toward a vulnerable young woman and his cowardly retreat the moment he is actually challenged sharply lower how he is perceived.

ambiguities: The narrator's own status shift ('plus maître, c'est-à-dire plus esclave') is explicitly paradoxical: apparent relational gain over Albertine is simultaneously presented as a new dependency, so it is recorded as mixed rather than a clean elevation.
